name: Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) Builder
definition: An algorithm to construct a Sparse Voxel Octree from a list of voxels using GPU compute shaders. It processes the voxel list level-by-level, flagging nodes, allocating memory for internal nodes, and storing leaf nodes.
summary: The Sparse Voxel Octree Builder constructs a dense, contiguous flat array for GPU raycasting by recursively expanding nodes based on occupancy, unlike queue-based methods that merge nodes dynamically.
